title: The Vent Field Compact
openingText: Ko meets you barefoot on stone warm enough to blister, in front of a vent field that has just gone quiet, and does not acknowledge either fact. 'The ground here ended a civilisation that thought it had three hundred years,' she says. 'It has been eleven minutes since the vents stopped. Say what you came to say inside that.'
openingTextLate: Ko meets you on the warm stone as before, but her people have moved camp twice since last season and the vents have opinions now. 'The interval is shorter,' she says, without greeting. 'Everything I told you before, halve it. Talk quickly.'
dialogueCordial: Good. Short, and true, and inside the time. The Pact can use you.
dialogueStrained: That is a great deal of words for a field that is about to have an opinion.
dialogueHostile: You are arguing on ground that is warming under you. I will not warn you twice.
dialogueWalkaway: Then run, and run west, and do not stop at the colonnade.
dialogueWalkawayLate: Then run west, do not stop at the colonnade, and this time do not stop after it either.
dialogueAccept: Agreed. Stand where I stand and the field will not take you. Step off it and I cannot help.

terms.description: Ko's line across the plateau, the stone that has finished cooling.
Cutting rights on the obsidian field. It cuts better than steel, exactly once.
The Cinderbound will know you kept terms on the warm ground. That travels.
You hold a vent picket for one rotation. People do not always come back from one rotation.
The quiet is not a lull. Ko knows the interval and it expired yesterday.
terms.rumorText: Ko's people watch the vents the way sailors watch a flat sea: held too quiet, held too long.
